criteria.description: POST /equipment (Dealer, TANK) creates a tank with capacity/product, returns 201
criteria.verification: backend/src/routes/equipment.test.js: create-tank test passes under `npm test` in backend/ (Decimal fields compared via Number(...))

criteria.description: POST /equipment (Dealer, DISPENSER) creates a dispenser with no capacity/product/currentMeterReading, returns 201
POST /equipment (Dealer, NOZZLE) creates a nozzle attached to an existing dispenser with the supplied currentMeterReading baseline, returns 201
POST /equipment with a malformed body returns 400
POST /equipment with a stationId belonging to a different dealer returns 403
POST /equipment (NOZZLE) with a parentEquipmentId that isn't a DISPENSER at the same station returns 404
POST /equipment with an Admin token returns 403
GET /equipment (Admin) returns all equipment across the network
GET /equipment (Admin) with ?stationId= returns only that station's equipment
GET /equipment (Dealer) returns only their own station(s)' equipment (default, unfiltered)
GET /equipment (Dealer) with ?stationId= set to their own station narrows to that station's equipment
GET /equipment (Dealer) with ?stationId= set to another dealer's station returns an empty array
GET /equipment for a Dealer-role caller with no linked dealerId returns 403
GET /equipment/:id returns 404 for a non-existent id (Admin caller)
GET /equipment/:id returns 403 for a Dealer requesting another dealer's equipment via dealerScope
PATCH /equipment/:id (Dealer, own TANK) updates capacity/product; type/stationId/parentEquipmentId/currentMeterReading remain unchanged even if included in the request body
PATCH /equipment/:id (Dealer, own DISPENSER) with a capacity in the body leaves capacity as null
PATCH /equipment/:id (Dealer, own NOZZLE) updates identifier; currentMeterReading remains unchanged even if included in the request body
PATCH /equipment/:id returns 403 for a Dealer acting on another dealer's equipment
DELETE /equipment/:id returns 403 for a Dealer acting on another dealer's equipment
PATCH and DELETE /equipment/:id are both unreachable by an Admin token (403 via requireRole('DEALER'))
DELETE /equipment/:id on a DISPENSER with an existing child NOZZLE returns 409
DELETE /equipment/:id on a nozzle, then its now-childless dispenser (in that order), both succeed with 200 and the deleted row's JSON
/equipment routes reject an unauthenticated caller with 401 on both a collection route and a :id route
criteria.verification: backend/src/routes/equipment.test.js: unauthenticated tests pass for both route shapes
